verdict.rationale: Linear documents a deprecation policy: it marks deprecated fields with the GraphQL @deprecated directive, lists API changes with an [API] prefix in the changelog, and promises proactive outreach and lead time before breaking changes. The same docs state the API is explicitly not versioned, so the versioned-API half of the story is not delivered. missing for 10: API versioning (explicitly absent), concrete deprecation timelines or sunset windows, independent corroboration of how the policy works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: If there's a noticeable breaking change in the API, we'll proactively reach out to developers that use that part of the API and give you plenty of time to make changes
We utilize the `@deprecated` directive to annotate deprecation warnings in the schema.
